definitions.normal: n = d_t (unit normal of the homogeneous slices)
definitions.tilted: u = cosh b(t) e_0 + sinh b(t) (c1 e_1 + c2 e_2 + c3 e_3), e_1 = a1^-1 d_x, e_2 = (a2 e^{sx})^-1 d_y, e_3 = (a3 e^{sx})^-1 d_z; group-invariant (frame components depend on t only)

gauss_identity.identity: R3 = 2 G_ab u^a u^b + (-2/3) Theta^2 + (1) sigma^2 + (1) omega^2  (sigma^2 = sigma_ab sigma^ab, omega^2 = omega_ab omega^ab)
gauss_identity.non_integrability_note: for omega != 0 no family of 3-surfaces is orthogonal to u (Frobenius), so R3 is the Gauss-equation curvature of the formal rest spaces, not of actual hypersurfaces; the beta omega^2 term is exactly the correction the identity acquires there

ke_obs_vorticity_theorem.closed_form: omega_ab omega^ab = (S^2 sin^2 phi / 2) * (S cos(phi) (H1 - H2) - sqrt(1+S^2) c/a1)^2,  S = sinh b, c = 1 (type V) / 0 (type I)

matter_frames.pi_n_amplitude: (1 + w) rho sinh^2 b (traceless, along the tilt)
matter_frames.q_n_mag: (1 + w) rho cosh b sinh b

aligned.M_t: 2*S_sinh**3*Derivative(a3(t), t)/(a1(t)*a3(t)) + 2*S_sinh**3*Derivative(a2(t), t)/(a1(t)*a2(t)) - 4*S_sinh**3*Derivative(a1(t), t)/a1(t)**2 + S_sinh**2*sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*Derivative(a3(t), (t, 2))/a3(t) + S_sinh**2*sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*Derivative(a2(t), (t, 2))/a2(t) - S_sinh**2*sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*Derivative(a1(t), t)*Derivative(a3(t), t)/(a1(t)*a3(t)) - S_sinh**2*sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*Derivative(a1(t), t)*Derivative(a2(t), t)/(a1(t)*a2(t)) + 2*S_sinh**2*sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)/a1(t)**2 + S_sinh*Derivative(a3(t), t)/(a1(t)*a3(t)) + S_sinh*Derivative(a2(t), t)/(a1(t)*a2(t)) - 2*S_sinh*Derivative(a1(t), t)/a1(t)**2
aligned.M_x: -S_sinh**3*a1(t)*Derivative(a3(t), (t, 2))/a3(t) - S_sinh**3*a1(t)*Derivative(a2(t), (t, 2))/a2(t) + S_sinh**3*Derivative(a1(t), t)*Derivative(a3(t), t)/a3(t) + S_sinh**3*Derivative(a1(t), t)*Derivative(a2(t), t)/a2(t) - 2*S_sinh**3/a1(t) - 2*S_sinh**2*sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*Derivative(a3(t), t)/a3(t) - 2*S_sinh**2*sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*Derivative(a2(t), t)/a2(t) + 4*S_sinh**2*sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*Derivative(a1(t), t)/a1(t) - S_sinh*a1(t)*Derivative(a3(t), (t, 2))/a3(t) - S_sinh*a1(t)*Derivative(a2(t), (t, 2))/a2(t) + S_sinh*Derivative(a1(t), t)*Derivative(a3(t), t)/a3(t) + S_sinh*Derivative(a1(t), t)*Derivative(a2(t), t)/a2(t) - 2*S_sinh/a1(t) - sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*Derivative(a3(t), t)/a3(t) - sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*Derivative(a2(t), t)/a2(t) + 2*sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*Derivative(a1(t), t)/a1(t)

transverse.M_t: S_sinh**2*sqrt(S_sinh**2 + 1)*(a1(t)**2*a2(t)*Derivative(a3(t), (t, 2)) - a1(t)**2*Derivative(a2(t), t)*Derivative(a3(t), t) + a1(t)*a2(t)*a3(t)*Derivative(a1(t), (t, 2)) - a1(t)*a3(t)*Derivative(a1(t), t)*Derivative(a2(t), t) + 2*a2(t)*a3(t))/(a1(t)**2*a2(t)*a3(t))
transverse.M_y: S_sinh*(-S_sinh**2*a1(t)**2*a2(t)*Derivative(a3(t), (t, 2)) + S_sinh**2*a1(t)**2*Derivative(a2(t), t)*Derivative(a3(t), t) - S_sinh**2*a1(t)*a2(t)*a3(t)*Derivative(a1(t), (t, 2)) + S_sinh**2*a1(t)*a3(t)*Derivative(a1(t), t)*Derivative(a2(t), t) - 2*S_sinh**2*a2(t)*a3(t) - a1(t)**2*a2(t)*Derivative(a3(t), (t, 2)) + a1(t)**2*Derivative(a2(t), t)*Derivative(a3(t), t) - a1(t)*a2(t)*a3(t)*Derivative(a1(t), (t, 2)) + a1(t)*a3(t)*Derivative(a1(t), t)*Derivative(a2(t), t) - 2*a2(t)*a3(t))*exp(x)/(a1(t)**2*a3(t))
